LESSON: KUANDIKA 13.3.1 INSHA ZA KUBUNI INSHA YA MAELEZO

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 13
Topic 13.3: Kuandika 13.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Insha ya maelezo

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Kuandika 13.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Insha ya maelezo. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kutambua vipengele vya insha ya maelezo kuhusu mahali
2. kujadili vipengele vya insha ya maelezo kuhusu mahali
3. kuandika insha ya maelezo inayodhihirisha sifa za mahali

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kutambua vipengele vya insha ya maelezo kuhusu mahali
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua vipengele vya insha ya maelezo kuhusu mahali. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kujadili vipengele vya insha ya maelezo kuhusu mahali
   In simple words: practise until you can kujadili vipengele vya insha ya maelezo kuhusu mahali. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. kuandika insha ya maelezo inayodhihirisha sifa za mahali
   In simple words: practise until you can kuandika insha ya maelezo inayodhihirisha sifa za mahali. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Kuandika 13.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Insha ya maelezo using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Kuandika 13.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Insha ya maelezo in the examples.
2. Explain Kuandika 13.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Insha ya maelezo to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kuandika 13.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Insha ya maelezo.
4. Show that you can: kutambua vipengele vya insha ya maelezo kuhusu mahali

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Kuandika 13.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Insha ya maelezo using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kuandika 13.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Insha ya maelezo important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kutambua vipengele vya insha ya maelezo kuhusu mahali
2. kujadili vipengele vya insha ya maelezo kuhusu mahali
3. kuandika insha ya maelezo inayodhihirisha sifa za mahali

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
